MOVBbNUk_Eg.title: Akers Brothers Podcast Ep 57
MOVBbNUk_Eg.description:
Are you cultivating a heart that is ready to receive God’s Word?

Jerry and I sat down tonight for a powerful, unscripted conversation to talk about Jesus' famous Parable of the Sower. We went into this discussion with an open heart, and the Holy Spirit completely had His way—guiding our thoughts, deepening our insights, and taking the conversation into places we didn’t expect.


The Call: Healed of Leukemia by accepting God's Call
by Joey Sandlin
https://a.co/d/0fdqvf4N


Faith Over Everything: Living Victoriously Overcoming by faith in the Word of God.
by Joey Sandlin 
https://a.co/d/0005R3we

Faith Life Champions
Bible Institute
https://flcbi.net

F2Mhv_mUI1o.title: Akers Brothers Podcast Ep: 58
F2Mhv_mUI1o.description:
💡 Can you tell the difference between the true kingdom and the counterfeit?
In this episode, Jerry and Jacob Akers sit down with Pastor Jeremy Bender for an in-depth, hour-long conversation unpacking one of Jesus' most profound and timely parables: The Wheat and the Tares (Matthew 13:24-30, 36-43).
Together, they dig deep into the historical context of agricultural counterfeits, the challenge of living faithfully in a mixed world, and the ultimate comfort of God’s sovereign justice. Whether you are studying the parables for the first time or looking for deeper theological insights, this discussion offers practical wisdom for modern believers navigating culture today.

📖 Scripture Referenced:
• Matthew 13:24-30 (The Parable)
• Matthew 13:36-43 (Jesus' Explanation)

GXztul0xaYw.title: Akers Brothers Podcast EP 59
GXztul0xaYw.description:
In this video, Jerry and I sit down with our mom to dive into Chapter 2 of Secrets of a Prayer Warrior by Derek Prince. Our discussion leads us into deep reflections on scripture, focusing on faith, seeking God's kingdom first, and the life-giving power of His words. We also take a special moment to honor and remember our mom's dad and our grandpa, Richard Arnold McCleese.

📖 Scriptures Mentioned

• Hebrews 11:6 – "And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him."
• Matthew 6:33 – "But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well."
• Proverbs 4:20-22 – "My son, pay attention to what I say; turn your ear to my words. Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart; for they are life to those who find them and health to one’s whole body."

🔖 Timestamps

0:00 - Intro
1:30 - Discussing Secrets of a Prayer Warrior (Chapter 2)
5:15 - Unpacking Hebrews 11:6, Matthew 6:33, & Proverbs 4:20-22
12:45 - Remembering Grandpa Richard Arnold McCleese
18:20 - Closing Prayer & Outro
If this discussion blessed you, please Like, Comment, and Subscribe for more family Bible studies and faith-filled conversations!
#Faith #PrayerWarrior #BibleStudy #FamilyDevotional #Scripture #Legacy
